question.text: Equity investors have a ______ claim on a company's assets and earnings.

explanation.text: The Logic: Equity holders are the last to be paid after all debts and liabilities in liquidation. The Trap: Preferred shares have priority; equity is residual. Cross-Exam Context: Consistent with XV, V-A, X-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Explain residual claim to clients so they understand equity's downside in distress.
